final_message:
The change is unlikely to pass.

The delete path is unchanged, so nonexistent review IDs will not reliably produce `404 Not Found` as required. The update also throws `ResourceNotFoundException` when the review has no description, which is unrelated to missing-review handling and may reject valid edits. Additionally, the aggregate recalculation introduces potentially fragile assumptions about review relationships and rating types.

VERDICT: FAIL
CONFIDENCE: 94
